title: Multiplicativity of the Kronecker Symbol (Both Arguments)
description: Proves that the Kronecker symbol is completely multiplicative in both arguments: (ab/n) = (a/n)(b/n) for ab != 0, and (a/mn) = (a/m)(a/n) for mn != 0. Uses case analysis with kronecker0 and kroneckerNeg1 multiplicativity for special moduli, and Jacobi symbol multiplicativity (jacobiSym.mul_left and jacobiSym.mul_right) for the general case.

mainTheorems.name: kronecker_mul_left_proved
mainTheorems.statement: kronecker (a * b) n = kronecker a n * kronecker b n
mainTheorems.description: Complete multiplicativity of the Kronecker symbol in the first argument, for nonzero a*b.

mainTheorems.name: kronecker_mul_right_proved
mainTheorems.statement: kronecker a (m * n) = kronecker a m * kronecker a n
mainTheorems.description: Complete multiplicativity of the Kronecker symbol in the second argument, for nonzero m*n.

mainTheorems.name: kronecker0_mul_of_ne_zero
mainTheorems.statement: kronecker0 (a * b) = kronecker0 a * kronecker0 b
mainTheorems.description: Multiplicativity of kronecker0 (the unit character at modulus 0).

mainTheorems.name: kroneckerNeg1_mul_of_ne_zero
mainTheorems.statement: kroneckerNeg1 (a * b) = kroneckerNeg1 a * kroneckerNeg1 b
mainTheorems.description: Multiplicativity of kroneckerNeg1 (the sign character at modulus -1).

overview.text: Proves the Kronecker symbol is completely multiplicative in both arguments. First argument: case analysis on n with kronecker0/kroneckerNeg1 multiplicativity at special moduli. Second argument: case analysis on m,n being ±1 or general, with sign factor analysis and jacobiSym.mul_right.
overview.proofStrategy: First argument: case split on n = 0, -1, 1, general; use kronecker0_mul, kroneckerNeg1_mul, jacobiSym.mul_left. Second argument: case split on m,n = ±1 (special) vs general; use kronecker_neg_modulus for sign introduction, then jacobiSym.mul_right with sign(m)*sign(n) analysis for 4 quadrants.
